briefing.headline: AMZN climbs 1.49% as mega‑cap tech leads overnight gains
briefing.summary: All ten core mega‑cap tech tokens posted modest advances, with AMZN, AMD and AAPL leading the rally. Broad market proxies SPY and QQQ also rose, though at a slower pace. The only core decliner was NVDA, while a suite of smaller or leveraged tokens (CAPR, AAOX, IRE, CSIQ, SOXL, MUU, NVDL, NVDX, SKHU, SKHX) suffered steep drops. Overall breadth was positive but uneven, driven by strength in the large‑cap tech sector.
